items.informal_name: Cardinality of Cartesian Product of Finite Sets Equals Product of Cardinalities
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Finset α),
  (s.finsupp t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ of indices and a function $ t $ mapping each index to a finite set, the cardinality of the Cartesian product $ \prod_{i \in s} t(i) $ is equal to the product of the cardinalities of each $ t(i) $, i.e., $ \left| \prod_{i \in s} t(i) \right| = \prod_{i \in s} |t(i)| $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Dependent Finite Support Functions Equals Product of Component Cardinalities
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Zero (α i)] (s : Finset ι)
  (t : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)), (s.dfinsupp t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ over an index type $ \iota $ and a family of finite sets $ t(i) $ for each $ i \in s $, the cardinality of the set of dependent finite support functions constructed from $ s $ and $ t $ is equal to the product of the cardinalities of $ t(i) $ over all $ i \in s $. Symbolically, $ \#(s.\text{dfinsupp } t) = \prod_{i \in s} \#(t(i)) $.

items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] (f : ι →₀ Finset α), f.pi.card = f.prod fun i => ↑(f i).card
items.informal_description: For a finite support function $ f : \iota \to₀ \text{Finset}(\alpha) $, the cardinality of the Cartesian product $ \prod_{i \in \text{support}(f)} f(i) $ is equal to the product of the cardinalities of each $ f(i) $, i.e., $ \left| \prod_{i \in \text{support}(f)} f(i) \right| = \prod_{i \in \text{support}(f)} |f(i)| $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Dependent Function Product Equals Product of Support Cardinalities
items.type:

  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)] (f : Π₀ (i : ι), Finset (α i)), f.pi.card = f.prod fun i => ↑(f i).card
items.informal_description: The cardinality of the finite set of dependent functions with finite support constructed from the family $ f(i) $ is equal to the product of the cardinalities of each $ f(i) $ over the support of $ f $.

items.type:
∀ (ι : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : Zero α] [inst_3 : Fintype α],
  Fintype.card (ι →₀ α) = Fintype.card α ^ Fintype.card ι
